events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: A City Reborn

options.text: Agree to build towers across the cities.
Offer to build urban sites for the displaced to settle.
Refuse to commit to providing aid.

events.text: On a tour of the city of [city], you are shocked by the sight of burnt out houses, rubble-filled streets and the lines of people leaving the city, seeking to escape the destruction. [character] has asked for help for the city of his family. The scenes of destruction and destitution stay with you,. Will you help the people of the [family] city?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: A Dark Pall

options.text: Time to shuffle off this mortal coil.

events.text: A black dog follows wherever you go. The throne gives you no comfort. Your inner circle consists of sycophants, and your subjects see you as just one more miserable tyrant in an endless succession of monarchs. The only honorable end is to become one with the darkness.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: A Glint of Greed
events.text: We have noticed your growing obsession with gold, and it worries some on the court. However, a robust economy benefits us all. Perhaps we can cooperate to make your dreams of prosperity come true. What is it you desire?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: A Long Ride

options.text: You will lead the nation to [ambition].
Decide to [ambition].
The time is right to [ambition].
Why spoil the moment with thoughts of ambition?

events.text: The wind whips across your face as you race across the land around [city], your steed responding to the lightest touch as you work in perfect unison to navigate the sharp bends and clear the hurdles of tangled bushes and winding streams. You reach a particularly beautiful view and pull to a stop. With quiet amusement you notice the guards trailing behind, desperately trying to keep up. There is plenty of time before they reach you and your mind races with thoughts and ideas brought on by the ride. Looking out across your nation you decide which direction to pull the reins.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: A New Decree

options.text: Let the people know your plans to [ambition].
Decree that you will [ambition].
State your ambition to [ambition].
Seek to forge your own path.

events.text: As [rival] grows, the decrees and laws of the nation are what keep order. The families are eager for you to make a new decree on the future of [rival]. Will you publicly plot a path forwards for the nation?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: A Voice in the Dark

options.text: This is a sure sign that [religion] is the one true faith!
I want others to feel this close to! We will build places of holy reflection.
This was not but some cruel trick of nature.

events.text: There are tales of a cave near to [city], where the [religion] believers are shown the divine will of. Deciding to see for yourself, you travel the short ride and enter the darkness of the cave. Tendrils of smoke cling to your legs with every step, creeping through cracks in the rock and climbing your body. You breathe deeply, feeling strangely calm. And then there is nothing. Awakening in your chambers, you remember glimpses of strange voices and visions of creatures wreathed in flame. The guards who pulled you out of the cave claim that you were muttering in a language that they could not understand.

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Age of Oligarchs

options.text: If we can't beat them, join them. The people will just have to suffer.
We must negotiate concessions to stop these abuses, whatever the cost.
We will play the families off against each other and re-secure our power.

events.text: The noble families run roughshod over the people, unbridled in their lust for power and their disdain of your weak rule. The people suffer and mock you as a weak and foolish ruler, while dreaming of better days under the former leader [character]. The nation is at a crossroads. What shall we do to set this right?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Ambitions of Faith

options.text: Agree to [ambition].
Agree to [ambition].
Refuse [character] request.

events.text: [character] has come before you as a representative of the [religion] religion, asking that you [ambition] or [ambition]., the man makes a compelling case for how this support could help relations between the crown and the religion, leading to increased support in the future. Will you lend your aid to and the?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: An Age of War

options.text: A strong economy will support our armed forces.
Specialists will allow the flow to trade to continue, even in war.
We will not be defined by these times.

events.text: The people of [rival] are tired. The multiple wars have families, supplies and patience stretched thin. Discontent is on the rise, with the people of [city] marching through the street in mobs. Members of your court have gathered to suggest that a plan is needed to encourage the people and restore their spirits, before you are faced with rebels at home as well as abroad.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: An Epic Legacy

options.text: I will not compete with such a figure.

events.text: The Epics of your people are told by word of mouth, inscribed in stone and depicted in painting. Most popular among these stories is the tale of [character], the legendary founder of [rival]. The legacy of such a name inspires awe, yet also brings a certain responsibility. Will you try to live up to the name of he who came before you?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Ancestral Oath

options.text: Agree to build the towns.
Focus on increasing production.
Refuse to bow to their demands.

events.text: [character] stands in front of the court, claiming that it is time for you to repay the oath that was once sworn between your two families in the days of [character] and [character]. The [family] demand an extensive reform that will undoubtedly benefit them, with increased production and an emphasis on developing towns for them to manage as hubs of trade. With some careful application of royal authority, you are able to negotiate down to one commitment.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Assembled Generals

rewards.text: Progress ambition: Two Max Level Unit

options.text: ...but maybe a different path would be better?

events.text: You enter the tent where your generals have gathered to await you. Each has ridden from their own commandment to attend this military council, but if they are tired then it is well hidden beneath a layer of steely discipline. [character] <p.is_sub.S1=SUBJECT_HERO>is practicing a speech under his breath<p=SUBJECT_COMMANDER>is giving orders to a messenger<p=SUBJECT_TACTICIAN>is reading a treatise on enemy tactics<p=SUBJECT_ZEALOT>is clutching his weapon<else>is giving orders to a messenger<end> while [character] <p.is_sub.S2=SUBJECT_HERO>studies the pitted marks that cover his well-worn shield<p=SUBJECT_COMMANDER>barks orders at the royal guard<p=SUBJECT_TACTICIAN>pours over a map of the surrounding terrain<p=SUBJECT_ZEALOT>paces back and forth<else>looks over a map of the land<end>. [character] sits to one side<p.is_sub.S3=SUBJECT_HERO>, eying up the others with an unconcerned grin<p=SUBJECT_COMMANDER>, at ease in the military camp<p=SUBJECT_TACTICIAN>, reflecting on different plans and strategies<p=SUBJECT_ZEALOT>, alone in silent prayer<else> in calm reflection<end>. They stand to attention as you enter. It doesn’t take long for the arguments to flare once the meeting begins. Each general has a differing opinion on the best course of action. It falls to you to navigate this battlefield.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Avenging the Banner

options.text: We will make their people pay dearly for their victory.

outcomes.label: Avenging The Banner General Kills Five
Avenging The Banner General Kills Ten

options.text: We need to let this loss go.

events.text: [character] charges into the hall in full armor, clamoring to a halt in front of you. “I cannot abide this dent on my honor, please let me back onto the field to take the fight to the [rival] and avenge the loss of our banner!”

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Before the People

options.text: “…to a new future!”
“…only the best!”
“…thank you all!”

events.text: “My friends, my people.” There is absolute silence as you speak, the gathered nobles and diplomats hanging on your every word. You feel a smile creep towards your lips as you relish being in your element, but you push it down before it can show itself. The tone you are setting is of serious grandeur, even a small gesture out of place could ruin the illusion. “We are gathered here to honor a new year, a time of potential. A time for looking back, but also for looking forward to the days ahead.” The speech continues, the audience enraptured by your skills as an orator. This is it, the finale. A strong promise of action would be a climatic ending, but will you voice such a commitment?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Behind the Throne

options.text: His ideas for improving the court and administration are interesting.
These are impressive plans for the military.
I will decide another path.

events.text: [character] has not been idle. Your spouse approaches you in your chambers, bringing a scribe laiden with various plans for the future of [rival]. Laying them in front of you, he begs you to take a look at his ideas. A few stand out...

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Bound by an Oath

options.text: Swear to repay the promise.
Refuse to bow to their demands.

events.text: [character] stands in front of the court, claiming that it is time for you to repay the oath that was once sworn. The [family] demand that you must [ambition].

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: By Cloak And Dagger

options.text: Yes, we should make an effort to know as much as possible about our neighbors.
I will not stoop to such tactics.

events.text: [character] stands eerily still, waiting for you in the dark. Ever the schemer, he has a plan to spread the influence of [rival] by developing a network of spies and agents. In a hushed voice, [character] warns that at a recent party he caught three spies attempting to influence your court in [city]. Your own agents would make sure that you're not caught unawares and provide opportunities to undermine your enemies. Will you step into the shadows?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: By Our Borders

options.text: Order reserves of military equipment and experienced officers.
Order the construction of new barracks and ranges.
Give no new orders.

events.text: As the borders of [rival] and [rival] draw closer over time, tensions have been brewing along the boundaries. Reports have arrived that there has been raiding between nations as opportunistic bandits turn to seizing animals, grain and any valuable goods from foreign villages to make some fast money without incurring the anger of their own authorities. The families are worried that these tensions could lead to further conflict with [rival] and urge you to prepare the nation's defenses.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: By Sword and Siege

options.text: Their armies must be stopped!
Only a decisive strike at their cities will stop this.
There are other considerations at play.

events.text: [rival] banners lie piled at your feet, but the tenacious nation is not yet defeated. Your General [character] comes before you for orders, stating that your soldiers are weary from the fighting and eager to see their homes. He suggests that a great offensive strike could help push the balance and show the might of [rival] once and for all. What will your orders be?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Carthage Is Born

options.text: Send scouts to find new resources and landmarks.
Mark out land for your cities.
Focus on improving your nation’s lands.

events.text: When you fled Tyre, little did you suspect that the end of your time there would also mark the beginning of a new nation to surpass your origins. Even as [character] stews in his foreign palace, you watch as the cities of [rival] prosper, new buildings and districts growing each year. What is next for your young nation?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Challenged by the Heir

options.text: I will not be goaded by the actions of a fool.

events.text: Your heir [character] has made his anger apparent at every possible occasion. In an especially embarrassing turn, when the court is gathered to hear the appeals of a discontent noble, [character] calls you out in front of all present, claiming that your rule has led to a sorry state of affairs in [rival]. He ends by demanding to know what you are planning on doing to show your worth. Although they would never voice opinion against you, the others of the court turn, clearly curious to hear your answer.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: City of Wonders

options.text: Decree that you will [ambition].
Decree that you will [ambition].
Maybe I am getting carried away.

events.text: The wonders of [city] are known far and wide. Looking across the city, you can’t help but agree that it truly is a marvel. And yet… You know in your heart that you are a builder, could you not exceed them if you tried? Spotting an empty area of land that would be a perfect site, you can almost hear the bricks being laid, the creak of the wooden cranes lifting stone. Filled with passion, you summon the court architect. To work!

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Daily Veneration

options.text: The gods of our ancestors will always protect us.
Maybe there are gods beyond those of our lands?
The gods need a voice beyond the esoteric ways of the priests.
I am the one who will shape this nation, not the gods.

events.text: The veneration of the gods of [rival] are closely tied to daily activity in the cities where they are worshiped. Events are followed by rituals, deals are sealed with sacrifices. As you observe the burning of a lamb, you wonder if [rival] will always be tied to these ways or if there is another path.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Defined By War

options.text: Fighting is enough of a challenge.

events.text: The war with [rival] is threatening to define your rule in the eyes of the people of [rival]. Your name inspires as a leader in combat, yet is that all that will be remembered of your achievements? As reports return of another sortie against the enemy forces, the question remains: Will you commit to this path of war? Or do you aim to follow a different road?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Developing Ambitions

options.text: The [family] ask that you [ambition].
The [family] ask that you [ambition].
The [family] ask that you [ambition].
I will forge my own path.

events.text: There are few corners of the world that the name of [rival] has not yet reached. However, are never content and remain eager for you to. The three heads have gathered before you to make requests for the future of [rival]. [character] represents the [family], [character] the [family] and [character] speaks for the [family] family. As the leaders make their case it is up to you to decide the future of [rival].

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Drunken Ambition

options.text: “Of course, why would you doubt it?”
“Well yes, we can do that…”
“Why would you listen to me when I’m drinking!?”

events.text: The crowded people of the court sway as your vision swims. The previous night is especially blurry in your memory. Just as you try to recall the details, [character] speaks up. “We are pleased to hear of your plans to advance the nation. [character] says that you spoke extensively on the matter at his dinner last night. If those are, indeed your plans?”

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Early Ambitions

options.text: Decree that you intend to [ambition].
Decree that you intend to [ambition].
Decree that you intend to [ambition].
None of these ideas suffice.

events.text: The families of your young nation are eager for you to prove your power and legitimacy to rule. The three heads have gathered before you to make requests for the future of [rival]. [character] is first, bowing before you to make his plea for you to [ambition]. [character] goes next, detailing the [family] plan for you to [ambition]. Finally is [character] of the [family], that it would be in the nation’s best interest to [ambition]. The families have spoken, but which in direction will you lead [rival]?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Ebb and Flow

options.text: We will invest in ships to gain control of the seas.
Harbors will welcome traders from across the waters.
My legacy will not be boats and huts!

events.text: The sea air dances down the streets of [city], eddying around the buildings and pulling at the hair and clothes of those going about their daily business. The elders of the city are showing you the markets that have sprung up along the coast, asking for further investment to trade by sea. The sound of the waves mingles with the bustle of the merchants as you decide if [rival] should turn to the sea.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Empty Accomplishments

options.text: The largest, most populous Nation in the world.
A Nation that conquers and consumes its rivals.
There will be other ambitions.

events.text: Ministers have expressed concern over the current heir's disinterest in his studies. Instead of working with tutors, [character] spends his days strolling the gardens and envisioning future political victories. "I will achieve many great things when I am king. The question is which goal to undertake first."

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Enemies Together

options.text: Prove your worth by taking to the field.
Dismiss these claims by the might of your armies.
Rise above the baseless claims.

events.text: Another day, another argument with [character]. The man has a unique way of pushing until you start to see red. In a particularly heated argument, [character] dares to question your military abilities, claiming that they have been vastly over-exaggerated by your being [title]. Will you let this stand!?

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Fall Equinox

options.text: We must build a defensible haven, for only in security is there peace.
We must rely upon our people in times of trouble.
I saw countless hordes stand ready to defend our nation at all times.
No. I'm quite content with what I have.

events.text: It is fall, and cool, crisp air nips at your skin, taunting you with the promise of long nights and winter's chill. Your family and members of the court have gathered to celebrate the fall equinox and this year's bountiful harvest. Darkness grows with each passing day, and soon light will be on the retreat, but for now there is a joyous balance between the sun and moon. Your people look to you for guidance in the dark times ahead. How shall we remember this blessed day and ensure that future generations may enjoy the same?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Family Ambitions

options.text: Support the [family] and [ambition].
Support the [family] and [ambition].

events.text: A of the [family] and a of the [family] have each made a request of the court, asking for you to support their family. The [family] family while the [family] family. Will you start an ambition to try and curry favor with one of the noble houses?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Family Favors

options.text: Support the [family] and [ambition].
I must not play favorites.

events.text: The smell of rich meats and wine rests in the air, gently mixing with the soft bubbling of conversation between family and friends. Nearly all of the [family] family have gathered together at the palace, many of the lesser members you have never even seen before. [character] is sitting by your side, a place of honor for the head of the family. He gestures for a servant to refill your wine. "My [title], I apologize for asking about work at this celebration, but I have been thinking about the future of the family and would appreciate your support." He leans in to whisper the favor in your ear.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: For Your Entertainment

options.text: I am staying out of this.

events.text: "The baths and theater are clearly superior!" [character] cries out. "You [family] wouldn't know culture if it sang in your face," [character] rejoins. "Libraries and courts provide entertainment and education. They are obviously the better option." As far as court arguments go, it is rather endearing to hear the nobles debate the ways to entertain their people. Will you weigh in, or abstain from the discussion?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: For the Faith!

options.text: We will express our faith through the most magnificent buildings.
We must bring the faith to the unbelievers.
No, none of these feel right.

events.text: [character] has requested a meeting, without the usual accompanying priests and entourage. As you greet the head of your State Religion, he looks upon you. “I always appreciate your zeal, [character], but there is so much more to be done. I believe calling you to take action once again.” Will you answer this call?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Forming a Nation

options.text: I will shape [rival] in a different way.

events.text: As the laws of the court are read out to the people, the court themselves are engaged in celebration and merriment. One of the court scholars rises to give a speech: “A civilization is not a static being, but a dynamic entity built on the decisions of the people within. The laws of [rival] have taken their first shape, painting a picture of our future. Praise to [character]!” As you reflect on your path, ambition swells from within. What shape do you wish for this fledgling nation?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Founding Nation

options.text: I will follow a different path.

events.text: The nation of [rival] grows day by day, year by year. Your people look to you, the founder who staked out this new land, to provide guidance and to prepare for tough winters ahead. There is much to be done to grow your nation. Where to begin?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Friends and Allies

options.text: Refuse to commit to anything.

events.text: A diplomatic meeting provides a rare chance to speak to your ally [character] in person rather than through a series of messengers. Although most of the day is taken up by rote formalities, in a brief interlude at dinner, [character] speaks to you in a conspiratorial whisper: "Come now, [character], we are allies! I am sworn to you like you are a brother, yet there is so much I still don't know about you. Will you tell me of your plans for [rival]?"

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Fuel for the fires

options.text: We will ensure that the sacrificial pyres never die out.
There are many gods, and all deserve praise.
The gods can fend for themselves.

events.text: The [family] family are staunch worshipers of [religion], often calling upon the favors of <p.is_sub.S3=SUBJECT_PLAYER_ROME>Jupiter<p=SUBJECT_PLAYER_EGYPT>Ra<p=SUBJECT_PLAYER_GREECE>Zeus<p=SUBJECT_PLAYER_PERSIA>Atar<p=SUBJECT_PLAYER_ASSYRIA>Ashur<p=SUBJECT_PLAYER_BABYLONIA>Ishtar<p=SUBJECT_PLAYER_CARTHAGE>Melqart<p=SUBJECT_PLAYER_HITTITE>Arinnitti<else>the gods<end>. Their family head, [character], has come before you, claiming that the gods have demanded a show of dedication from the people of [rival]. What will you command?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Glory for

options.text: I will build majestic buildings of praise to the almighty!
We will train priests to lead the faithful.
I seek glory for myself alone.

events.text: Your devotion to is a part of your daily life, subtly shaping your actions and guiding your hand. But a meeting with the religious elders questions if there is more that could be done. Others of the faithful look to you for guidance, will you take action to shape [rival] into a realm worthy of [religion]?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Growing Ambitions

options.text: Decree that you intend to [ambition].
Decree that you intend to [ambition].
Decree that you intend to [ambition].
I will forge my own path.

events.text: As [rival] grows, the families vie for power and your favor. The have gathered to offer their ideas for the future of [rival]. [character] of the [family] has a plan to [ambition]. [character] of the [family] interjects that it would be better to [ambition]. Finally is [character] of the [family], that it would be in the nation’s best interest to [ambition]. The families have spoken, but in which direction will you lead [rival]?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Growing Rivalry

options.text: We will research all we can to improve ourselves.
Focus on training our military to be prepared for anything.
I do not see [rival] as our rivals.

events.text: [rival] is closely mirrored by our neighbor, [rival]. The proximity of their nation, in both position and power, has led to a wary tension between the two. Your subjects pass around rumors of the strange practices of their people and ministers fret over the threat of war if they turn their gaze toward our resources. Your advisers suggest taking action to prepare in case of a rise in [rival] power.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Inquiring Minds

options.text: We support the pursuit of knowledge.
Tackle something smaller.

events.text: Sages in [city] are convinced that the world still holds many secrets, and they request that we conduct further inquiries into the natural sciences. They are confident of a breakthrough...

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Internal Strength

options.text: No, the heir should chart his own path.

events.text: [character] has previously shown an admirable strength in challenging situations, but he now grows idle. What projects shall we propose to keep the heir aspiring to greatness?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Judgment

tip: As leader: +50 Unit Trait XP / Infantry
As governor: +100 Unit Trait XP / Infantry

options.text: We need a standard set of laws to clearly mark the punishments for crimes.
The nation should be able to provide food to those that need it.
Sadly these things happen.

events.text: The court stand gathered, watching as you deliberate the sentencing. The criminal before you is a lesser noble, driven to desperation by the plague that decimated his family and the father that had already squandered his inheritance. Still, theft from the crown is no small offense and <p.is_sub.S1=SUBJECT_PLAYER_DIVINE_RULE>as the divine ruler <p=SUBJECT_PLAYER_LEGAL_CODE>as you are all bound by the same legal codes, <else><end>it falls to you to decide his fate. After the ruling, the case stays with you. Is there more that could have been done?

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Known Unknowns

options.text: I will know more... in due time.
The ministers, the entire court... I think I must consider them in a new light.

events.text: Even as you lay your head down, the day's reports of troop movements, foreign intelligence and treasury shortfalls continue to flicker behind your eyes. Ambushes lie in wait behind every unknown. If you and [rival] are to survive, you must know more. Or... must you? The smallest part of your mind whispers, does it even matter, if you can't trust what you are already being told?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Land of Veneration

options.text: We will create a land of holy ground.
No, I will not set us on this course.

events.text: The scribe comes into you chamber and lays out the scroll that was asked for, an illuminated list of the holy cities of the known world. [city], <p.is_sub.S0=SUBJECT_CITY_ZOROASTRIAN_HOLY_SITE>the city of the Zoroastrianism<p=SUBJECT_CITY_JEWISH_HOLY_SITE>the site of the Judaism holy of holies<p=SUBJECT_CITY_CHRISTIAN_HOLY_SITE>the center of Christianity<p=SUBJECT_CITY_MANICHAEAN_HOLY_SITE>the city of the Manichaeism followers of Mani<else>the holy city<end>. [city], <p.is_sub.S1=SUBJECT_CITY_ZOROASTRIAN_HOLY_SITE>the city of the Zoroastrianism<p=SUBJECT_CITY_JEWISH_HOLY_SITE>the site of the Judaism holy of holies<p=SUBJECT_CITY_CHRISTIAN_HOLY_SITE>the center of Christianity<p=SUBJECT_CITY_MANICHAEAN_HOLY_SITE>the city of the Manichaeism followers of Mani<else>the holy city<end>. [city], <p.is_sub.S2=SUBJECT_CITY_ZOROASTRIAN_HOLY_SITE>the city of the Zoroastrianism<p=SUBJECT_CITY_JEWISH_HOLY_SITE>the site of the Judaism holy of holies<p=SUBJECT_CITY_CHRISTIAN_HOLY_SITE>the center of Christianity<p=SUBJECT_CITY_MANICHAEAN_HOLY_SITE>the city of the Manichaeism followers of Mani<else>the holy city<end>. [city], <p.is_sub.S3=SUBJECT_CITY_ZOROASTRIAN_HOLY_SITE>the city of the Zoroastrianism<p=SUBJECT_CITY_JEWISH_HOLY_SITE>the site of the Judaism holy of holies<p=SUBJECT_CITY_CHRISTIAN_HOLY_SITE>the center of Christianity<p=SUBJECT_CITY_MANICHAEAN_HOLY_SITE>the city of the Manichaeism followers of Mani<else>the holy city<end>. Why should other nations have such access to the divine, surely [rival] is the most holy of all?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Leave it Marble

options.text: Decree that you will [ambition].
Decree that you will [ambition].

events.text: You gaze out from your palatial balcony on a vast city of brick and lumber, and cannot help but envision greater things. With court financial support at your disposal, you might construct a grand monument made of fine materials, and thereby secure your legacy for all time. What construction project will you undertake?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Legacy of the [title]

options.text: You will lead the nation to [ambition].
Decide to [ambition].
The time is right to [ambition].
There is no time, leave ambition to the young.

events.text: How do you want to be remembered? The many years of your life make themselves felt in your every movement, but you are not yet too old for action! Knowing that the end is likely close brings a certain clarity and purpose. Will you use your lasting vigor to aim for a new ambition?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Legacy of the [title]

options.text: You will lead the nation to [ambition].
Decide to [ambition].
The time is right to [ambition].
I will be patient before deciding my path.

events.text: [rival] is held together by the legitimacy of your dynasty, those with the ambition and the heritage to rule. All eyes are on you and how you will steer the nation. What will you aim for? What legacy do you wish to leave behind?

Will you take inspiration from this ancient figure?

[character] should have kept to the jokes.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Forgotten Town

options.text: We should gather food in case such disease spreads across the land.
We must make sure to use every natural resource that is available to us.
This is just the way of the world.

events.text: The town clings to the side of the hill, blending seamlessly with the jagged rocks around it. The run down structures are almost invisible from the path below, passed by countless travelers without a second thought. Your attention was brought here after overhearing a servant speak of how the people were struggling after a disease spread through their herds. Your heroic nature <p.is_sub.S0=SUBJECT_GREEDY>overcame even your greedy tendencies,<p=SUBJECT_COMPASSIONATE>and natural compassion demanded action,<else>spurred you to action,<end> and you now lead a cohort of soldiers with emergency grain for the forgotten town. Starving faces look up in a mix of gratitude, confusion and surprise. How many other forgotten are out there? It raises the question, once again, of how best to serve the people.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Fortune Teller

options.text: Well, if the stars say so…
Infrastructure needs to come first.
Take this argument elsewhere, houses nor mills are my priority.

events.text: [character] grasps a smoldering bundle of herbs in his ink stained hands, “I have been reading the portents!” he cries. “There are clear signs in the stars that you are destined to see the population of [rival] grow!” The ever-cynical [character] gives a faint snort. “Very likely. And what wood are you going to use to build these new cities and houses? Lumbermills should clearly be our first priority.”

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Ghost of [character]

options.text: Agree to the demands.
Promise a building plan that will serve the people.
Call your own supporters to take up arms in your defense!

events.text: Even beyond the grave, your twin brother [character] is creating problems. A faction of his supporters has taken to the streets in [city], demanding that you accept the laws that [character] wanted to put in place as [title]. Will you bow to these demands or plow forwards on your own path?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The God-[title]

options.text: I am favored, possessor of the lands.
It is my strength that grants me the title of [title], not some god.

events.text: As [religion] spreads, a myth has grown about the nature of your birth. People claim that it was who created you, calling on the other gods to make for you a body, a soul and the will for life. As the chosen, it is only right that all should bow to you. Will you sit at your rightful place as the child of a god?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Influence of Pygmalion

options.text: Pay close attention to his lesson on keeping power.
He will never set foot in our land!

events.text: Although in far off Tyre, [relative] [character] still sends the occasional message. The latest is both intriguing and troubling. In it, he offers to come to live in [rival] for a time, if you allow him to act as your adviser and to give you council. The rest of the message is a detailed treatise on the consolidation of power. Will [character] come to [rival]?

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: The Jewel of [rival]

options.text: It's no use thinking about it.
[character] is nothing special. I shall prove it.

events.text: They say that the beauty of Hanging Gardens of [city] is enough to make a grown man weep. They say that the gods themselves envy the garden's delicate splendor and luxury. They say that [character] is exalted among men for his patronage of the magnificent [city]. You wish that they would shut up already.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Legacy of [character]

options.text: I will find my own path.

events.text: The legacy of [character] still resonates through the [rival] world. His name is used as an example of ideal rule, and he remains the subject of many tales, songs and plays. How does a [title] live up to such a great legacy? The question returns as you find yourself facing yet another application to erect a statue of the historic ruler.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Library of Ashurbanipal

options.text: Gather scribes to amass a great library of documents and teachings.
Train acolytes to pass down the myths and stories of your people.
I will prove my worth through the strength of my sword.

events.text: Although there is always war, political intrigue and dynastic squabbling to occupy your time, it is the writings of the scholars that most often draws your attention. But there is no time for idle fascination; named king above your elder brother, there is a great pressure to show yourself worthy of the title. Perhaps there is a way for these goals to align?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Memory Endures

options.text: My memory is testament enough.

events.text: The loss of [character] strikes you at the most mundane of moments. Grief will suddenly appear, wrapping it self around you until it feels impossible to move. The pain of his passing will never entirely leave you, but maybe there is a way to honor the memory of your lost child?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Mouth of [rival]

options.text: Celebrate our laws and remind them of our culture.
Warn them that our archers will line every wall if they think to attack.
I leave it to your own initiative.

events.text: Your diplomats stand gathered, held in high esteem before the court. One in particular has outshone the others, making headway with the nation of [rival] and endearing them to us. has asked for a message to bear when next riding out, the direction for [rival] that will help forge alliances.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Next Generation

options.text: [character] suggests hoarding the riches of [rival].
[character] suggests taking the fight to our enemies.
Hopefully they will gain some sense as they grow.

events.text: You bring your children [character] and [character] to the throne room one evening, to sit in your place and to feel the responsibility of leading [rival]. As they take turns, one of your advisers asks them what change they would implement first as ruler. Interested, you listen on, curious if either will impress you.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Old Ways

options.text: Maybe we should be open to change.

events.text: The pagan ways of [rival] are surrounded by new religions like [religion] and [religion]. But the old ways are a part of life and culture, interwoven into the very fabric of your way of being. What does it mean to the future of [rival] and your rule if these ways die out?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Other Path

options.text: I will think on this before deciding.

events.text: The laws of the land can greatly shape a developing nation. Although [rival] and [rival] have started down different paths, there is still so much potential in what your nations will become. Even as their people are telling Epics of their heroes, yours are practicing Exploration and venturing into the wilds. Every route you find opens new possibilities and you find yourself reflecting on the road your nation is on. Where will it lead you next?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Path to Victory

options.text: We will delve and harvest the land for all that it’s worth.
This just shows how much is still to be discovered!
Sometimes patience is the best course of action.

events.text: [character] comes before you, still caked in layers of dried mud and dust from exploring the lands of [rival]. He claims to have found an abundance of resources that could be useful to the nation, delicately drawing them up in a map of the lands. As you study the detailed cartography, painted with cities, rivers and mountains, you imagine yourself flying above like a bird, with the land spread out beneath you. From this vantage point, your eyes examine even the smallest detail for a way to gain a tactical advantage.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Pythia Speaks

options.text: We will raise a hand of peace to those near to us.
We will raise our religious practice through theology.
Refuse to listen to the warnings.

events.text: The Pythia of Oracle of [city] has spoken: "Remember the tides of fate O dwellers of [rival], the rolling waves of foam and time that not even the gods can control. Rise, climb above with quivering fingers and a yearning heart, or be dashed upon the rocks laid out before you."

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Pythia Speaks

options.text: Our cities will be bedecked with the riches of the world.
We will rule the land with absolute control, together.
Refuse to listen to the warnings.

events.text: The Pythia of Oracle of [city] has spoken: "Listen, [character], first of the [rival]. Bring not a broken chain to pull your people forwards. He by your side will be entertained, by your rise or by your fall."

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Pythia Speaks

options.text: We will build the walls as commanded.
We must build a fleet of ships as our 'wooden walls'.
Refuse to listen to the warnings.

events.text: The Pythia of Oracle of [city] has spoken: "Hear your fate, O people of [rival]. Weep for your children, those to fall to the blades of [rival]. Even your statues shiver with dread. Look to your one salvation, the wooden walls that will stand for generations to come."

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Riches of [rival]

options.text: Our building projects will be the wondered at across the world!
We should use these riches to support our people.
This will be invested into our armies to train the best military force.
I have different ideas for how this could be used.

events.text: The treasuries of [city] and [city] are overflowing, great wealth hoarded in the stone vaults. As your ministers share their reports on the state of the nation, the question forms in your mind of whether the wealth from these cities is best left alone, or if it should be invested back into the improvement of [rival]...

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Shape of Law

options.text: We are strengthened by the deals with our allies.
[rival] should be able to thrive without any external aid.
None of these feel right.

events.text: The laws are a vital part of society and one in particular has been playing on your mind; <p.is_sub.S2=SUBJECT_PLAYER_EPICS>the practice of recording epics has seen the culture of [rival] grow with tales of gods and heroes, weaving a story of national identity<p=SUBJECT_PLAYER_EXPLORATION>your people have taken to the seas and wild lands after the declaration of Exploration, but it is a dangerous voyage from which many do not return<p=SUBJECT_PLAYER_TOLERANCE>the practice of Tolerance has opened the nation to all faiths, but religious divides between the people continue to persist<p=SUBJECT_PLAYER_ELITES>the nobles have more power than ever with the protection of Elites, but their ambition inevitably looks higher<else>a small change to the boundary marking of farms has seen an increase in the number of complaints, making it difficult for the courts to keep up<end>. These are not small decisions, each law can ripple out into a multitude of different aspects of daily life, affecting all from your own family to the lowliest peasants. But that is what makes them so important. Here is a chance to shape the nation, will you let it by?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Six Boards of War

options.text: We will bring every aspect of our might to bear on our enemies.
I will oversee the army myself.

events.text: The [family] family have proposed a system of organization to manage the increasing might of the [rival] army. A council of generals will be split into six boards, each of five members, overseeing the navy, transport, infantry, cavalry, chariots, and elephants. Each branch works together and contributes to success on the field.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Threat of Tyre

options.text: Train specialist forces to repel any attack.
Send your armies to gain experience on the field of battle.
Refuse to commit to such actions.

events.text: [rival] is still young, a fledgling nation trying to find its way in the world. The already perilous path is made more frightening by the persistent threat across the sea, [relative] the tyrant [character] is waiting for a chance to strike at the ones who fled his kingdom. The nobles of [rival] are worried, asking that you improve the nation's defenses in preparation should [character] send forces to attack.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Walk

options.text: You will lead the nation to [ambition].
Decide to [ambition].
The time is right to [ambition].
No, but I do feel rested!

events.text: The wind passes through the trees as you walk through the [city]. Getting away from the palace has an invigorating effect, generating new ideas and questions of ambition. Will you take one of these ideas forwards?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Walls of [rival]

options.text: Six cities with six walls will be a tough fortress to crack.
Generals will prepare our troops in case of an attack.
There is no threat yet, diplomacy can still win out!

events.text: Diplomacy may be preferable in many situations, but strong walls and a solid defense are key to survival when talks break down. The anger of [character] has the families of [rival] tense and eager to improve the nation’s defenses. The [family] family ask for walls to protect the cities, while the [family] say that experience is key and that we need capable generals to lead a defense. Will you undertake either of these plans?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Wisdom of [character]

options.text: I will build monuments as a mark of our legacy.
The experience of elders is invaluable to our survival.
Bah, these are just the ravings of an old man!

events.text: Word has reached you that [character] has been spending his days in [city], acting as a wisdom teller and passing out advice to those who seek it. When asked what he is doing, [character] replies that no one in the court listens to the advice he gives, so why not go to those who respect the voices of their elders? Leaning in to you, he offers some words of wisdom on the passing of time and the end of all things. "Listen to them. Or not, that is the choice of the young."

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Three Moves Ahead

options.text: A decisive strike will leave [rival] weakened.
A decisive strike will leave [rival] weakened.
A decisive strike will leave [rival] weakened.
Victory will be won through strategies we haven’t even imagined yet.
We need to arrange our own side of the board before looking outwards.
Sometimes patience is the best course of action.

events.text: The small circular tiles lay scattered across the board. To many the positioning would seem random, but to your strategic mind they paint a picture of soldiers and kings caught in the ebb and flow of power. It is time for your next move, but careful thought is needed first. Action must be sharp, decisive, with a clear objective in mind. There is no taking back a decision. Will the <p.is_sub.S1=SUBJECT_PLAYER_PEACE>peace<p=SUBJECT_PLAYER_WAR>war<p=SUBJECT_PLAYER_TRUCE>truce<else>current balance of power<end> with [rival] last? Will the [rival] make their move? Whatever happens, you know you must be three steps ahead. You pick up the tile.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: To Hear Your Voice

options.text: Our cities will spread across the land!
It is the strength of our people that will see us prosper!
The gods wish to be praised through song and dance!
Carefully refuse to commit to an ambition.

events.text: The crowd gasps as the morning sun streams down upon you, catching the metallic strands of your clothes with dazzling effect. Standing outside of the temple, arms stretched, sheathed in a gown of white and gold, how could any doubt the divinity of your rule? People hush and listen attentively, hoping for a proclamation of the will of the gods.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Together in the World

options.text: Admit that you have always wanted to [ambition].
Affirm that you do have plans, to [ambition].
Profess your desire to [ambition].
We are not so close that I would share my secrets.

events.text: [character] company has been a great help the past weeks, the endeared companion jumping to your aid no matter the cost. One evening you share a drink as thanks, and the conversation leads to your ambitions. [character] shares that one day he hopes to. He turns expectantly to you, will you share your own ambition?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Too Much of a Good Thing

options.text: Gods do not need medicine.
Bring me wine and companionship!
More physicians cannot hurt.

events.text: The court physician takes you aside to speak privately. He has noticed that you exhibit the symptoms of a mysterious illness afflicting many of the city's spas and brothels. "Too much carousing can topple any ruler," he advises.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Troubling Behavior

options.text: To slay as many enemies as he can.
To punish those who believe differently than he does.
There will be other ambitions.

events.text: Several of the palace's veteran military trainers have come to us with a problem. Namely, [character]. While skilled in his drills, the heir exhibits a glaring lack of respect, and his behavior towards others is troubling. One afternoon, you hear [character] describe his goals for the throne. This may be your one chance to intervene.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: True Successor

options.text: I will not pursue my own ambitions.

events.text: As you sit on the throne of [rival], a slither of doubt sits uncomfortably in your chest. You may rule for now, but you know that [character] is still out there, waiting to return to the throne. Time is short. It is vital to make the most of your current power, to either secure it for yourself or to path the way for [character]. How will you make your mark and secure your legacy?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Trusted Council

options.text: [character] suggests exploring the hidden routes of the world.
[character] advises researching ways of updating our economic power.
[character] asks that we seek knowledge, peace, and trade.
I will not take their advice this time.

events.text: The members of your council have gathered together to discuss the state of affairs in [rival]. Your Spymaster [character] is seated, an aura of surrounding him. Chancellor [character] as you enter. Ambassador [character] gives you, "Shall we begin?" Personal opinions aside, each has their own suggestion for the best steps to guide [rival]. Will you take their council?

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Tutorial: Ambition

options.text: Control Four Cities.
Kill Five Enemy Units.

events.text: You have unlocked the ability to choose an Ambition. Ambition are goals that your Family would like for you to pursue, and completing them will grant you, and all of your descendants, a permanent boost to Legitimacy. Completing an Ambition unlocks a new one and completing ten is one way to win via Ambition, so always do your best to fulfil your current Ambition. Here are a couple of simple Ambition to get you started.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Ultimate Ambitions

options.text: The [family] ask that you [ambition].
The [family] ask that you [ambition].
The [family] ask that you [ambition].
I will forge my own path.

events.text: The power and legitimacy of your dynasty is well known, and the families of your nation are eager for you to live up to the title you possess. The have gathered before your court in the to make suggestions for the future of [rival]. [character] represents the [family], [character] the [family] and [character] speaks for the [family] family. As the leaders make their case it is up to you to decide the future of [rival].

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Unpopular at Court

options.text: I cannot rule like this. Better to step down from the throne than be pushed from it.

events.text: [character] has been skilled indeed at forging every grievance, every shred of resentment, among the nobility of [rival] into an agitated coalition on the brink of boiling over. While all loudly demand concessions, many also quietly speak of a new King.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Warning of Days to Come

options.text: Refuse to listen to the warnings of the god and let the books burn.
Promise to elect a special priesthood to care for the books if she gives them to you.
Pay for the texts yourself, keeping them to try and divine the will of the gods.

events.text: [character] has twice been approached by [religion] priestess, giving the [title] a chance to buy her oracular writings. Originally offering nine books, when her offer was rejected she burned three of them. Returning later, she offered the remaining six at the same price. [character] refused again and so another three went up in flames. You hear that the priestess is due to return with the last three books. Will these texts, which she claims divine the observances and rituals that may help [rival] to avoid calamities, also be lost to the fire?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Warrior Clan

options.text: Agree to research new techniques and equipment.
Order the development of new organizational practices.
Refuse to commit your support to this arms race.

events.text: The [family] elders have invited you to watch a display where their finest soldiers show off their hunting prowess and perform complex military drills. The persistent family ask that you commit to furthering the organization and tools of your military, a vital aspect of their way of life.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Whispered Ambitions

options.text: Markets will allow us to keep an eye on the trade being conducted.
Our own production of Iron will be even greater than theirs.
This isn't a threat to us.

events.text: To the undiscerning eye, the stood before you looks like a common peasant off the street, but you know better. is one of your agents from [city], reporting back in person. Speaking with respectful and downcast eyes, gives an account of a recent speech made in the city by [character] to the people, where he proposed a new plan to train the finest iron-workers to increase trade to their neighbors and improve the weapons of their armies. Schemes immediately start forming in your mind. Will you take advantage of this new knowledge?

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Winter Solstice

options.text: I imagine a magnificent building where people can come together in good faith.
The world is a wonderful puzzle, and we must find the answers.
We must reach out and exchange goods, ideas, and dreams with the world.
No. I'm quite content with what I have.

events.text: It is winter, and frost crunches beneath your feet. The sun rests low in the sky, and the winds whistle among your clothing, freezing skin at their touch. Your family and members of the court have gathered to celebrate the winter solstice and pray for the yearly return of the warmth. Darkness reigns triumphant, but only for a time as the court joyously celebrates the dark's certain downfall. The darkness is a time for change and renewed direction. How shall we remember this frigid day and ensure that future generations may enjoy the same?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Wisdom of the Oligarchs

outcomes.label: Wisdom Of The Oligarchs Sages Scribes
Wisdom Of The Oligarchs Sages Library 1
Wisdom Of The Oligarchs Sages Library 2
Wisdom Of The Oligarchs Sages Library 3
Wisdom Of The Oligarchs Clerics Shrines
Wisdom Of The Oligarchs Clerics Monasteries
Wisdom Of The Oligarchs Clerics Temples
Wisdom Of The Oligarchs Clerics Cathedrals

options.text: I will plot a different path for [rival].

events.text: [character] and [character] sweep into your chambers, the hems of their richly embroidered robes gliding just above the floor. The [family] Sages and the [family] Clerics both strive to explore and understand the world, in their own ways. The two oligarchs explain that they are in agreement that building new places of learning will greatly benefit the future generations of [rival] and have come to ask for your support. Will you commit to aiding either of the families?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Wise Outlook

options.text: No, the heir should chart his own path.

events.text: [character] never looks up from his studies, spending long hours with scrolls by candlelight. The heir seems to be taking his responsibilities to the state very seriously. With so many initiatives for him to choose from, what do we suggest?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Wondrous Ambition

options.text: I will build wonders that surpass even the Pyramids!
The Pyramids will stand watch over a sea of buildings.
We will not be influenced by those who came before.

events.text: The pyramids tower above the fields of [city], visible from miles around. Such monolithic structures have become a thing of awe and wonder, some wondering if such a feat of construction would even be possible in current times. Although this wonder of your dynasty raises your name, the looming tombs are a reminder to make your own mark on the world, or be forgotten. Will they inspire you to action?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Worship on the Streets

options.text: Decree that there will be festivals to across [rival].
Support the [family] plan to expand religious infrastructure.
Thank the citizens with a [religion] icon, to be placed at the heart of [city].

events.text: Worship of has spilled out onto the streets of [city]. The ecstatic worshipers feel safe in celebrating their religion, supported by the officials of the [family] family. The elders of the [family] mention how useful the have been in running the city and suggest that binding the state to a religion could be useful for all involved.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Zealous Ambition

options.text: There is still so much potential left to be unleashed!
I should celebrate the people and build them the best of everything!
No, none of these feel right.

events.text: There are no half-measures when it comes to your commitment. Every cause undertaken must be pursued with the most ardent passion, but recently nothing has ignited your zeal and instead there is only a listless sense of waiting. That is, until a parade in [city] passes by the palace. The people are celebrating the new year and seeing their passion for the times ahead ignites a familiar drive from deep within. They are right, this nation is amazing! And there is so much to be done!

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [character] and the Tribes

options.text: Very well, then it is war.

outcomes.label: Leader And The Tribes Tribe New
Leader And The Tribes No New

events.text: The peace with [tribe] is not to everyone’s liking. [character] and the [family] have been particularly virulent in their disgust at the agreement, convincing the other families that peace with the tribe shows you to be weak. In a speech before the court, the disgruntled [title] asks for a war with [tribe], demanding that their sites be used for [rival] cities instead.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [family] Ambitions

options.text: Agree to [ambition].
Offer to [ambition].
Turn them away.

events.text: The [family] family have sent representatives from [city] to speak before the court and make a plea for you to either [ambition] or [ambition], both goals important to the family’s ambitions. The family. Will you accept an ambition from this family?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [religion] Ambitions

options.text: Decree that you will [ambition].
Decree that you will [ambition].
Turn the away.

events.text: The leading [religion] of [city] have come to your court to request that you [ambition] or [ambition]. The emissaries claim that support for their ambitions would strengthen the religion's ties to the crown, an alliance between and [title] that will surely lead [rival] to greatness. Will you take on a new ambition?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [religion] Ambitions

options.text: Agree to [ambition].
Offer to [ambition].
Refuse to support [religion] at this time.

events.text: The [religion] [title], [character], is not to be taken lightly. The <p.is_sub.S0=SUBJECT_HIGH_COURAGE>fierce man is ferocious<p=SUBJECT_HIGH_WISDOM>wise man is studious<p=SUBJECT_HIGH_CHARISMA>charismatic man is relentless<p=SUBJECT_HIGH_DISCIPLINE>strict man is unyielding<else>diligent man is relentless<end> in seeking out support for [religion]. The [title] stands before you and makes the case for you to [ambition], reminding you of the importance of serving. Failing that, he suggests that you [ambition] instead, also desired by the. Will you take on an ambition to aid your State Religion?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [title] Ambitions

options.text: Turn [character] away.

events.text: [character] has come before you, his personal towards you. Driven by his religion’s your rule, the [title] that you [ambition], reminding you of. Will you accept this request?
